description: Fix issues identified in semantic review: UUID migration race condition, duplicated set_chat_room logic, i18n TODO for notification, and add-member bug that omits current user filtering.
steps: Rewrite db/migrate/20260602000006_add_uuid_to_dm_chat_rooms.rb to fix unique-index race condition
Create app/controllers/concerns/dm_chat_room_finder.rb concern to DRY up set_chat_room
Update all three DM controllers to use the concern
Add i18n TODO comment in streaming_dm.ts
Fix room_settings_modal.tsx to filter out current user in add-member flow
acceptance_criteria: Migration adds column as nullable, backfills, then adds NOT NULL and unique index
All three controllers use DmChatRoomFinder concern instead of duplicated set_chat_room
streaming_dm.ts has TODO comment about i18n limitation
room_settings_modal.tsx filters out current user from participant_ids when creating group room
findings: All Ruby syntax checks and TypeScript compilation pass cleanly. Migration rewritten to add column as nullable, backfill UUIDs, then add NOT NULL and unique index. DmChatRoomFinder concern extracts duplicated set_chat_room logic. Room settings modal now filters current user from participant_ids to avoid duplicate membership.
